title: Traverse eligible hosted consecutive Balanced splits once
question: Can two terminal hosted Balanced operations retain exact nested boundaries and observation while avoiding the intermediate frame scan?
summary: All six eligible pairs improved. At 1.228 GB of CSV the paired median saved 2.049 seconds, and tracked temporary reads fell by 1,313,314,474 bytes. Both original sizes and two independent size declines preserve exact ordered CSVs and stage statistics.

workloads: Bundled Chromium screen of the opt-in three-step prototype, and Chrome qualification of exactly two terminal root Balanced operations with a 256 MiB packed spool floor.
Plain UTF-8 output, Auto grouping, no calculated columns, valid leaf count and live headroom for four configured records plus 8 MiB.

validation.summary: Verified exact ordered CSV digests, stage statistics, strict caps, observed traversal rows and groups, and publication. Fresh below-floor controls passed unchanged timing bands; rejection and cancellation leave no incomplete output.

limitations: One WSL2 ext4 host, Chrome, synthetic CSV and uncontrolled OPFS cache state.
The first below-floor control drifted by 0.132 seconds toward the candidate despite identical route and accounting, beyond its 0.12-second symmetric band. Both fresh cases passed the original bands.
exclusions: The default guarded path excludes deeper chains, nonterminal chains, Prepare and native execution.
reopen_when: Eligible held-out work shows a repeated slowdown, admission regression or different exact split boundaries.
